test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question:
Given below are two statements

Statement I: If A, B and C are standing on a circle looking at the centre and B is just left of A, then C is just right of B

Statement II: If X, Y and Z are standing in a circle looking at the centre and X is just right of Y, then Z is just right of X

In light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true

solution:
**Statement I: **If A, B and C are standing on a circle looking at the centre and B is just left of A, then C is just right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a3474934e692ad6820477ad3e3f1583e81acbd26dd6b22cec59b5e4d2442f6.png] 

C is just left of B. 

Statement I is false.

**Statement II:** If X, Y and Z are standing in a circle looking at the centre and X is just right of Y, then Z is just right of X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3adffcf169a6b7dde8c35694e283538c94e09590d163b672dee04f83a36d9e43.png] 

Z is just right of X.

Statement II is True.

Hence, **Statement I is false but Statement II is true.**
